body_markdown: 🚨🆘🚨The death of the reactive response window is here. By Officer Anthony W. But no matter how fast a response team is, reactive mitigation means the damage is already done. To secure the future, we must eliminate the reactive response window entirely. At STEPSEVEN SOSSTSE, we are leading the paradigm shift from reactive response to preemptive safety and security, powered by the Quantum Internet of Everything (Q.I.E.)
